title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.17 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It repairs GitHub mathematical rendering with native fenced math, corrects the observation-descent witness and route-version wording, adds a subject/scope/method/evidence/authority map, validates public Markdown and local links, serves the exact schema linked by the Pages protocol, and keeps generated Knowledge headings structurally nested. No engine algorithm, accepted schema, degree-two route, or new mathematical authority is added. Exact replay conclusions remain bound to their subject, evidence, predicate, scope, method, and authority; documentation, local tests, release identity, transport, external scientific truth, and deployment authority remain separate. Release assets are built from exact tagged Git objects, keylessly attested before publication, and redownloaded for byte comparison. The protocol component remains byte-identical to 0.3.0-alpha.13, and the live Custom GPT remains the separately observed alpha.10 interface; the alpha.17 generated package is only an unvalidated future live-update candidate and indexed Knowledge bytes remain NON_ADMISSIBLE_UNHASHABLE. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
